payload.title: File:Wieslochia weissi.jpg
payload.credit_html: Mayr, G. and Manegold, A. 2006. New specimens of the earliest European passeriform bird. Acta Palaeontologica Polonica 51 (2): 315–323.
payload.description_html: Wieslochia weissi gen. et sp. nov., holotype, specimen SMNK−PAL.3980 from Frauenweiler near Wiesloch, Germany, early Oligocene (A) and interpretative drawing (B). Left (l) and right (r) elements are indicated. The toes of the right foot are numbered. Fossil coated with ammonium chloride.
